facts: INSPIRE polygons are captured against British National Grid
web-map use requires reprojection to the target CRS
reprojection from British National Grid to WGS84 may shift some features by up to 15 metres
spatial data must use OSGB 1936 British National Grid
polygons must be captured against large-scale Ordnance Survey mapping
accepted GIS formats include ESRI shapefile, MapInfo MID/MIF and TMF
where a shapefile is lodged HMLR processes the application on the shapefile alone if the land is clearly identifiable

promotion_rule: Parcel elevation sampling remains in EPSG:27700; a web-display reprojection is never used as measurement geometry without verified transformation.
